mapper.sql: mac.id, mac.agent_id, mac.merchant_id, mac.machine_sn, mac.machine_name, mac.machine_type, mac.bind_time, mac.status, mac.create_time, mac.update_time, a.agent_name as agent_name, m.merchant_name as merchant_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM machines mac LEFT JOIN agents a ON mac.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN merchants m ON mac.merchant_id = m.id WHERE mac.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM machines mac LEFT JOIN agents a ON mac.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN merchants m ON mac.merchant_id = m.id WHERE mac.machine_sn = #{machineSn}
SELECT FROM machines mac LEFT JOIN agents a ON mac.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN merchants m ON mac.merchant_id = m.id WHERE mac.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY mac.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM machines mac LEFT JOIN agents a ON mac.agent_id = a.id LEFT JOIN merchants m ON mac.merchant_id = m.id WHERE mac.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY mac.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM machines WHERE agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO machines (agent_id, merchant_id, machine_sn, machine_name, machine_type, bind_time, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{merchantId}, #{machineSn}, #{machineName}, #{machineType}, #{bindTime}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE machines SET agent_id = #{agentId}, merchant_id = #{merchantId}, machine_sn = #{machineSn}, machine_name = #{machineName}, machine_type = #{machineType}, bind_time = #{bindTime}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
